{{Conjecture|legends}}
Four '''[[Industrial Heuristics]] transports''' were used to transport 1,700 children and adolescents recruited from throughout the [[Daimanate]] as student interns for an [[arxeum]]&mdash;a mobile war [[University/Legends|university]] that the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Daiman]] had purchased from the [[Bactranate]]. However, this deal had actually been a bait intended to lure his older brother Sith Lord [[Odion]] to the planet [[Gazzari]]. During the [[Battle of Gazzari]], the four transports landed on the planet and disembarked the students. However, [[Odionate]] forces destroyed the arxeum and almost slaughtered the students. However, the students were rescued by the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Kerra Holt]] who managed to evacuate them aboard the [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] [[Jarrow Rusher]]'s transport [[Diligence (New Sith Wars)|''Diligence'']].
